notes:
Formal middleware profile -- APPLE / iPhone VTS input.

Unlike the two ho-debug-* profiles (which are pure pass-through references: zero renaming, no
curves, parameter = expression = the raw wire name), THIS file is a real middle layer: it takes
the device's ARKit shape values and SYNTHESISES the official VTubeStudio tracking parameters
from them, the way VBridger does for its VTS relay.

INPUT SIDE -- long-lived, per-device
  One row per iPhone VTS wire. The 52 shape rows RENAME the device's PascalCase wire
  (`JawOpen`) to the canonical camelCase name (`jawOpen`); the other 15 rows (head/eye pose,
  FaceFound, Hotkey, Timestamp) are not channel names, so there `parameter == expression`.
  THIS RENAME IS NOT OPTIONAL and is not a naming preference: the canonical vocabulary belongs to
  the upstream channel table (`HoFaceTrackingChannels.Names`), and the session resolves channels
  by walking the INPUT rows' `parameter`. A profile whose input parameter is `JawOpen` matches no
  channel at all, so the middle layer silently emits nothing.
  67 wires, measured (docs/PARAMETER_DEVICE_VERIFICATION.md, section 2). Do not derive wire
  names from a spelling rule -- doing that once produced 12 rows pointing at keys the phone
  never sends, and that failure mode is silent.

OUTPUT SIDE -- the controller contract
  Writes the official VTS tracking parameters we can derive (20 art axes), plus FaceFound.
  VTS's tracking list is a fixed built-in set of 98 names (33 face/mouse/audio, 26 hand,
  39 controller); the ones here are the face ones our input can actually feed.
  Explicitly NOT written: MousePositionX/Y (no mouse), Voice* and VoiceA..O (no microphone on
  this link), FaceAngry (experimental, iOS only, and no ARKit shape maps onto it).
  Also NOT written: VBridger's own custom outputs (MouthFunnel, MouthPucker, MouthShrug,
  Eye_Squint_L/R, MouthPressLipOpen, BrowInnerUp). Those are VB-private names that need a
  ParameterCreationRequest on the receiving end -- they are not VTS standard.
  Full per-parameter definitions, ranges and formula sources: docs/PARAMETER_HO.md.

WHERE THE FORMULAS CAME FROM
  Extracted mechanically from the local VBridger install, never hand-transcribed -- see
  .research/vbridger/extract_vts_formulas.ps1. Each row's notes name the preset it came from.
  Formulas are picked by PRESET, not by output name: VB's V3.0 EyeRightX is built from
  eyeLookIn_L / eyeLookOut_L and its EyeRightY adds browOuterUp_L, so the name does not
  describe the source.
  Exception: EyeLeftX/Y and EyeRightX/Y come straight from the device's own raw eye scalars,
  because the iPhone sends them and VB's synthesis reads a different axis than its name claims.

WHAT IS NOT CALIBRATED
  Shaping, not calibration. VBridger's own input-curve store is 68 rows of identity
  (0->0 / 1->1), so there is no calibration to copy from it, and its preset numbers describe
  its own channel set, not this one.
  The FaceAngle* / FacePosition* sign flips are VBridger's, transcribed structurally: the
  device axes they consume (Rotation_*, Position_*) have NOT been verified against them on
  hardware. Head position units are also uncalibrated (raw phone values pass through).
  Fix both on YOUR copy -- this file is the starting point, not the answer.

CURVES
  Every row carries an explicit curve. The vertical axis is the PARAMETER VALUE, not a
  percentage: writing 0..100 on an output row multiplies the blend-tree weight by 100.
  A row whose expression is a synthesis formula (Brows, MouthOpen, MouthSmile) has a 0.5-ish
  neutral and can leave 0..1, so its curve is deliberately wider than the nominal range.
  The device scalars are given +/-180 on BOTH layers -- a 0..1 default curve would silently
  clamp head rotation to 0/1 and look like "head pose was never wired up".

controller axis Lid/Left/BlinkWide (-1 wide, 0 neutral, +1 closed); used to be a built-in output row, now a normal row here
controller axis Mouth/Form = 2*VTS MouthSmile - 1 (0 = neutral); inlined so it does not depend on the VTS-named row

controller axis Mouth/Open (VTS MouthOpen); the tree wants 0 = closed. 响应曲线 = 死区（2026-09-27 实测）：|值| <= 0.02 归 0 —— 手机在"不张也不抿"时就抖在这个区间；0.02..0.05 是斜坡（斜率 1.667）；再外面恒等。量程归一（张满 = 实测 0.75、半张 0.4）不在这条曲线上，是控制器里把 MouthCore 的 Y 刻度挪成 0 / 0.4 / 0.75 做的。
controller axis Mouth/Press (VTS MouthPressLipOpen, two-sided: +1 lip spread, -1 press/roll)

controller axis Mouth/Jaw -- the jaw's VERTICAL axis (up/down), bipolar: 0 = rest, + = open, - = bite/press (jaw up, teeth together). 2026-09-27: mouthClose folded in (user: arkit has mouthClose and it participates in the composite while android does not -- that is how you detect the jaw moving while the lips are CLOSED, i.e. chewing; chewing is therefore a MOTION on this axis, no second layer needed). MouthJaw = JawSide x Jaw, 6 cells.

controller axis Mouth/JawSide -- the jaw's HORIZONTAL axis (left/right), bipolar: 0 = centered, - = jaw to the left, + = jaw to the right (contract family MouthJawSide). 2026-09-27 用户要“下巴左右移动”，线本来就有（jawLeft/jawRight）。
controller axis Mouth/X (VTS MouthX); +1 = pulled to the observed left
controller axis Mouth/TongueL (HQTongueLeft): follows the single ARKit tongueOut until a sided source exists
controller axis Mouth/TongueR (HQTongueRight): same as TongueL for now

controller axis Mouth/CornerL = clamp(mouthSmileLeft - mouthFrownLeft) (contract HQSmileFrownLeft, -1 sad .. +1 smile); the MouthCorner table holds the left-corner residual, MouthCore keeps the lip contour
controller axis Mouth/CornerR = clamp(mouthSmileRight - mouthFrownRight) (contract HQSmileFrownRight, -1 sad .. +1 smile); the MouthCorner table holds the right-corner residual

outputs.expression: clamp(sqrt(mouthRollUpper * mouthRollLower) * clamp((sqrt(mouthRollUpper * mouthRollLower) - 0.02) / 0.03, 0, 1) * (1 + 4 * jawOpen * jawOpen) * (1 - clamp((mouthPucker - 0.5) / 0.3, 0, 1)), 0, 1)
outputs.notes:
controller axis Mouth/Roll -- drives MouthCoreRollSwitch (1D, thresholds 0.02 / 0.12) which cross-fades TWO WHOLE MOUTH TABLES (MouthCore = resting / MouthCoreRoll = cat-mouth variant). 这一行 = **上下同卷判据 × 死区 × 下颌增益 × 噘嘴门**（都写在表达式里，曲线恒等）：
  ① **几何平均 `sqrt(rollUpper * rollLower)`**（2026-09-27 用户四条 5 秒实测）：**上下两根线必须一起动**才算卷唇 —— 两根一起动时 √积 ≈ 平均（所以旧的 0.18 / 0.45 口径不变），**只动一根时（噘嘴/噪声）直接归 0**。实测：真猫嘴 (0.355, 0.576) ⇒ 0.452；噘嘴 (≈0, 0.124) ⇒ **0**；静息 (≈0, 0.016) ⇒ **0**；M 收音 (0.021, 0.039) ⇒ 0.008。
  ② 死区：结果 <= 0.02 归 0，0.02..0.05 乘数形式斜坡，之上恒等。
  ③ 下颌增益 `1 + 4*jawOpen²`：张嘴时设备会把读数压低（用户报压到跟噪声分不清）⇒ 乘回来；增益必须在死区**之后**（否则噪声一起放大），且只看 jawOpen（看 Open 会形成正反馈回路）。
  ④ 噘嘴门 `1 - clamp((mouthPucker - 0.5)/0.3, 0, 1)`：第二道独立保险 —— **门开在 0.5** 是因为这台设备的 `mouthPucker` 静息偏置本来就有 ≈0.2（iPhone 203 帧实测 mean 0.1992 / 现场静息 0.17..0.35，见 docs/PARAMETER_DEVICE_VERIFICATION.md），开低了会误掐；噘嘴 0.975 照样掐死、真猫嘴 0.03 不碰。
  ⚠️ 常数（4 / 0.4 / 0.3 / 死区 0.02）都是待标定占位；标定见 docs/VTS_HQ_CONTROLLER.md §2.4。
  ⚠️ 读数不再是两根线的原始平均；原始值仍由 G1 的 mouthRollUpper/mouthRollLower 出口行无损直通。
  要**按键强制猫嘴**：直接写这个参数 >= 0.12。
controller axis Gaze/Left/X: the iPhone sends its own eye scalars, so we do not re-derive them

controller axis Brow/Left/Y = 2*VB BrowLeftY - 1 (0 = rest, +1 raised); VB mixes in the mouth pull. 2026-09-27 DEAD ZONE on the browDown term only: three calibrated 5 s rest takes (after device calibration) gave browDownLeft 0.108..0.2083 with the mouth term at ~0, so the plain row parked the neutral face 62..69 percent inside the frown column of BrowCoreL (a two-tick X axis is the worst case for a static bias). Dead zone = x * clamp((x - 0.24) / 0.02, 0, 1) => 0 up to 0.24, identity from 0.26. The mouth-pull term is deliberately NOT dead-zoned (it stays live); the real frown / nose-scrunch reading is 0.83 => -1.66, far above the knee, so saturation is unchanged. VB-parity export rows (BrowLeftY / BrowRightY / Brows) keep VB's own rest bias on purpose.

controller axis Brow/Right/Y = 2*VB BrowRightY - 1. Same browDown dead zone as the left row (x * clamp((x - 0.24) / 0.02, 0, 1)); the mouth term flips sign and stays live. Measured browDownRight at rest: 0.108..0.2083 (three calibrated 5 s takes).
controller axis Cheek/Left/Puff (HQCheekPuffLeft): follows the single ARKit cheekPuff until a sided source exists
controller axis Cheek/Right/Puff (HQCheekPuffRight): same as Left for now

controller axis Nose/Up -- ONE state only (0 = rest, 1 = nose pushed up / sneer). 2026-09-27 DEAD ZONE (x * clamp((x - 0.18) / 0.02, 0, 1)): the same three calibrated 5 s rest takes gave noseSneer 0.089..0.1514, which put the neutral face 13..21 percent into the nose-up cell of the NoseUp 1D table; the real action (squint + nose push) measured 0.70 avg / 0.75 max, far above the knee, so the 0.7 tick stays valid. 2026-09-27 用户定：脸颊在二次元角色上表现不了（CheekSquint/CheekPuff 两棵树删掉），鼻只留“鼻子上顶”这一个状态；它连带的内眼睑上抬 / 眯眼 / 眉毛内下移由物理共动带出（eyeSquint / browDown 那几根线本来就会一起动），所以不为它们各做检测。它喂 NoseUp（1D，2 格）。
